semiconductor_relevance: High — Handotai India is actively involved in the semiconductor supply chain by providing materials and equipment, specifically targeting the OSAT and Fab sectors.
summary: Handotai India Pvt Ltd is a deep-tech materials science company with a focus on developing and distributing materials for the semiconductor industry. They aim to indigenize the materials supply chain in India while also representing various international companies for raw materials and machinery.
capabilities: Manufacturing of adhesive tapes for OSAT/ATMP applications
Distribution of semiconductor wafers including compound semiconductors and silicon wafers
Providing customized dicing and thermal release tapes

regional_presence.India: Handotai India operates as a distributor and manufacturer within the Indian semiconductor market.
